fact: Between 19 June and 21 July 2023, five initial and advanced IT training sessions were held for 68 staff of the Ministry of Justice's civil registry directorate, taught by the ITMA.
title: Guiné-Bissau: Projeto GESTDOC realiza formações em Informática dirigidas a funcionários do registo civil
publisher: Camões - Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua
